Package com.tonic.analysis.query.parser

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ConditionParser
    Recursive-descent parser for the composable WHERE expression language.
    QueryLexer
    Tokenizer for the query DSL.
    QueryParser
    Parses the outer query shell - (FIND|SHOW) target [IN|DURING scope] [WHERE expr] [WITH runspec] [LIMIT n] [ORDER BY key] - and delegates the WHERE expression to ConditionParser, the composable matcher grammar.
    Token
    Token produced by QueryLexer.
